FILED s407 (Fable, from the drop-harvest sizing â docs/option-b-phase2-plan.md
Track C).  8 drops over the companion population (io/fflush.t, op/alarm.t,
op/fork.t x2, op/getpid.t, op/override.t x2, op/stat.t), all "Handle single
node of unknown type": PPI hands a PPI::Token::QuoteLike::Command for every
spelling, and the term walker's primary set accepts the backtick spelling only.
Probed:  my $c = qx{echo hi}; print "c=$c";  perl c=hi   PCL c=   (dropped, rc 0)
         my $d = qx(echo ho);                 perl d=ho   PCL d=
         my $e = `echo he`;                   both e=he
FIX: one primary arm â a QuoteLike::Command of any delimiter is the same term
as the backtick form (interpolating unless the delimiter is single quotes,
like q// vs qq//: `qx'â¦'` does NOT interpolate).  Guard rows for the four
delimiters + the qx'' non-interpolating inverse in a fileio/system test file.
BAR: the 8 companion drops disappear (census edited with cause), gate,
corpus-diff IDENTICAL (no perl-tests file uses the shape â verify).

DONE s415 (commit s415d).  ONE primary arm in Pl/PExpr.pm takes
PPI::Token::QuoteLike::Backtick AND ::Command, with the command body and the
interpolate-or-not answer read from PPI's own section record (a `''` section is
perl's literal form, so qx'...' does not interpolate and travels as a
single-quoted token -- a double-quoted one would re-interpolate the `$`).
Pl/VarAnnotator.pm's two interpolating-leaf predicates learned the class too:
a variable used only inside qx{} was invisible to them, which is a raw-slot /
capture verdict taken on incomplete information.
BAR MET: all 8 companion drops gone (io/fflush 1, op/alarm 1, op/fork 2,
op/getpid 1, op/override 2, op/stat 3 -> 2); corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111
files (no perl-tests file uses the shape, as the task predicted); lib
emission-ab 19/19 SAME; gate green.  Six guard rows in
Pl/t/system-block-01.t (four delimiters, the interpolating case, and the qx''
inverse), every one probed against perl 5.40.3 first.
